claude_proposed_widenings.name: natural_weapons.damageType → DamageTypeRef
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Natural Weapons requires a cast-time sub-choice of growth type (claws=Slashing, fangs/horns=Piercing, hooves=Bludgeoning). The current atom fixes damageType as DamageType; it needs DamageTypeRef (= DamageType | CastTimeChoice<DamageType>) to express this player-facing cast-time selection.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You grow claws (Slashing), fangs (Piercing), horns (Piercing), or hooves (Bludgeoning). When you use your Unarmed Strike to deal damage with that new growth, it deals 1d6 damage of the type in parentheses...
